verdict.rationale: Cognee documents `recall()` as its main retrieval entry point. It searches memory in one call and auto-selects a retrieval strategy, and it can draw on session memory as well as the knowledge graph. So one-call retrieval of relevant memories is evidenced, but nothing shows the output is a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block. Missing for 10: any token-budget or size-limit parameter on recall, documentation that recall returns an assembled prompt-ready context block rather than raw search results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
